x-m-el-sta-09.title: Samaynta garaaf ku madax-madaxaysa dhererka baarasha
x-m-el-sta-09.goal: Adigoo mid samaynaya, arag in ka bilaabidda dhidibka toosan qiime aan ahayn 0 ay beddesho sida saamiga dhererka baararka u muuqdo, oo dooro shuruudaha garaaf daacad ah.
x-m-el-sta-09.material: Iibka bishii ee laba badeecadood ayaa ku dhawaad isku mid ah: 52 A iyo 56 B. Marka xogtan loo sawirayo garaaf baar, waxaad ka bilaabi kartaa dhidibka toosan lambar s oo aan ahayn 0 (adigoo jaraya wax kasta oo ka hooseeya). Markaas dhererka baararka la arkayo wuxuu noqonayaa 52−s A iyo 56−s B. (Haddii s=0, dhererka la arkayo waa 52 iyo 56.)
x-m-el-sta-09.thinking.0: Hubi sida dejinta dhidibku u saameeyo barbar dhigga muuqaalka
x-m-el-sta-09.thinking.1: Hel dhowr qiime oo buuxiya shuruud
x-m-el-sta-09.thinking.2: Dooro hababka daacadda ah ee xogta loo soo bandhigo
x-m-el-sta-09.s.s1.prompt: Hel 3 qiimayaal kala duwan oo s ah oo baarka B uga dhigaya inuu u muuqdo ugu yaraan 3 jeer dherer baarka A. (s waa ugu yaraan 0 oo ka yar 52.)
x-m-el-sta-09.s.s1.hint.0: Geli s=0, 40, 48 oo hel saamiga dhererka la arkayo mid kasta.
x-m-el-sta-09.s.s1.hint.1: Hel qiyaastii qiimaha s halka saamigu ka bilaabmo inuu noqdo 3 ama ka badan.
x-m-el-sta-09.s.s1.ok.c1: s waa ugu yaraan 0 oo ka yar 52.
x-m-el-sta-09.s.s1.fail.c1: s waa inuu noqdaa ugu yaraan 0 oo ka yar 52.
x-m-el-sta-09.s.s1.ok.c2: Baarka B wuxuu u muuqdaa ugu yaraan 3 jeer dherer baarka A.
x-m-el-sta-09.s.s1.fail.c2: Dhererka la arkayo ee B (56−s) wuu ka yar yahay 3 jeer dhererka la arkayo ee A (52−s).
x-m-el-sta-09.s.s1.explain: Haddii s=50, dhererka la arkayo waa 2 A iyo 6 B, sidaas darteed si sax ah 3 jeer. Haddii s ka weyn tahay 50 oo ka yar 52, saamigu wuu sii weynaadaa. Iibka dhabta ahi waa 52 iyo 56, qiyaastii 1.08 jeer oo keliya, weli garaafku wuxuu ka dhigayaa inay aad u kala duwan yihiin.
x-m-el-sta-09.s.s2.prompt: Sidee u saxi lahayd garaaf marin habaabin ah sidan si uu daacad u noqdo? Dooro wax kasta oo ku habboon.
x-m-el-sta-09.s.s2.hint.0: Kala sooc haddii hab kasta uu caawinayo akhristaha inuu si sax ah u fahmo qiimayaasha ama uu u janjeerinayo dareenka hal dhinac.
x-m-el-sta-09.s.s2.hint.1: Si dhererka baaruhu u noqdo mid saamiga qiimayaasha la leh, xaggee ayay tahay inuu ka bilaabmo dhidibka toosan?
x-m-el-sta-09.s.s2.o.a: Ka bilow dhidibka toosan ee garaafka baarka 0
x-m-el-sta-09.s.s2.r.a: Waxaad doortay habka ugu aasaasiga ah ee dhererka baaruhu ka dhigayo mid saamiga qiimayaasha la leh.
x-m-el-sta-09.s.s2.o.b: Midabee baarka B oo keliya midab madow si uu u muuqdo
x-m-el-sta-09.s.s2.r.b: Xoojinta hal dhinac oo midab ah ayaa sii qalloociyaa dareenka. Su'aasha koowaad waa haddii dhererku si daacad ah u muujinayo qiimayaasha.
x-m-el-sta-09.s.s2.o.c: Ka dhig calaamadaha cabbirka kuwo is-dhow si farqiga u dhexeeya labada baarba uu u muuqdo mid weyn
x-m-el-sta-09.s.s2.r.c: Hagaajinta farqiga u dhexeeya calaamadaha cabbirka si loo weyneeyo farqiga waa hab kale oo marin habaabin ah oo keliya.
x-m-el-sta-09.s.s2.o.d: Ku qor qiimayaasha dhabta ah, sida 52 iyo 56, kor baararka
x-m-el-sta-09.s.s2.r.d: Waxaad u ogolaatay akhristaha inuu si toos ah u hubiyo qiimayaasha halkii dhererka.
x-m-el-sta-09.s.s2.o.e: Marka dhidibka toosan la jarayo, sawir calaamad jebin dhidibka oo u ogeysii akhristaha
x-m-el-sta-09.s.s2.r.e: Waxaad doortay hab aan qarin xaqiiqda ah in dhidibka la jaray.
x-m-el-sta-09.s.s2.explain: Garaaf baar, dhererku waa inuu la leeyahay saami qiimaha. Ka bilow dhidibka 0, ama haddii aad jarto, calaamadee xaqiiqdaas oo qor qiimayaasha dhabta ah si akhristuhu aanan loo marin habaabin. Weyneynta farqiga midab ama farqiga cabbirka ayaa dhab ahaan qalloocin ah.
x-m-el-sta-09.s.s2.acc.0: Ka bilaabidda dhidibka 0 iyo qorista qiimayaasha way ku filan tahay daacadnimo. Waxay ka wanaagsan tahay haddii aad sidoo kale ogtahay sida loo calaamadeeyo dhidib la jaray.
x-m-el-sta-09.s.s2.acc.1: Xitaa haddii aad jarto dhidibka, calaamadeyntiisa iyo qorista qiimayaasha waxay ka ilaalinaysaa akhristayaasha in lagu marin habaabiyo. Haddii suurtagal tahay, ka bilaabidda 0 ayaa ka fudud.

x-m-el-sta-05.title: Tuuris yar iyo tuuris badan: fursad mise been-abuur?
x-m-el-sta-05.topic: Dareen ku saabsan qiyaasidda iyo tijaabinta
x-m-el-sta-05.goal: Adigoo isticmaalaya xogta qalinjabinta, xukun fikradda ka dambeysa tijaabinta male-awaalka: xataa isla saamiga, sida ay u adag tahay in natiijo lagu sharaxo 'fursad' waxay ku xiran tahay tirada tijaabooyinka.
x-m-el-sta-05.material: Jihoon wuxuu tuuray lacag wuxuuna yiri, 'Waxaan u malaynayaa lacagtan in loo sameeyey inay madax ku dhacdo marar badan!' Waxaad ku socodsiisay qalinjabin kombuyuutar si aad u aragto imisa jeer ayaa natiijo sidan oo kale ah ay dhacdo lacag cadaalad ah (lacag halkaas oo madaxa iyo dabadu ay si siman u badan yihiin). Natiijooyinka qalinjabinta: (a) Tuurista lacag cadaalad ah 10 jeer ayaa la celiyey 1000 jeer, 7 madax ama ka badan na waxay soo baxeen qiyaastii 170 ka mid ah. (b) Tuurista lacag cadaalad ah 100 jeer ayaa la celiyey 1000 jeer, 70 madax ama ka badan na weligood hal mar kama soo baxin. Natiijooyinka dhabta ah ee Jihoon waa Xaaladda A (7 madax 10 tuurid) iyo Xaaladda B (70 madax 100 tuurid).
x-m-el-sta-05.thinking.1: Xukun sida fursaddu u sharxi karto natiijo
x-m-el-sta-05.thinking.2: Kala saar hubaal ahaanshaha iyo shaki
x-m-el-sta-05.prereq.0: Macnaha suurtagalnimada iyo tijaabooyinka soo noqnoqda
x-m-el-sta-05.s.s1.prompt: Kee ayaa caddayn ka xoog badan u ah sheegashada Jihoon ee ah 'lacagta loo sameeyey inay madax badan ku dhacdo'?
x-m-el-sta-05.s.s1.hint.0: Hel kee ka mid ah qalinjabinta (a) iyo (b) ayay Xaaladda A iyo Xaaladda B kasta la jaan qaadaan.
x-m-el-sta-05.s.s1.hint.1: Qalinjabin kasta, isbarbar dhig imisa jeer ayaa lacag cadaalad ah ay sidoo kale siisay natiijadaas.
x-m-el-sta-05.s.s1.o.a: Xaaladda A. Helitaanka 7 madax tuurid yar waa natiijada ugu yaabka badan
x-m-el-sta-05.s.s1.r.a: Qalinjabinta (a), xataa lacag cadaalad ah ayaa siisay 7 madax ama ka badan 10 ka mid ah qiyaastii 170 ka mid ah 1000 orod. Natiijo si joogto ah dhacda ma yaab badna.
x-m-el-sta-05.s.s1.o.b: Labada xaaladood labaduba waa 70% madax, sidaa darteed caddayntu waa isku xoog
x-m-el-sta-05.s.s1.r.b: Xataa haddii saamigu isku mid yahay, tirada tuurista oo kala duwan waxay beddeshaa sida ay u badan tahay inay fursad ahaan dhacdo. Isbarbar dhig shaxdaha qalinjabinta (a) iyo (b).
x-m-el-sta-05.s.s1.o.c: Midna caddayn maaha. Lacag cadaalad ah ayaa sidoo kale madax ku dhici karta 70% ee waqtiga
x-m-el-sta-05.s.s1.r.c: 'Waa dhici kartaa' iyo 'badanaa way dhacdaa' way kala duwan yihiin. Gudaha (나) aad bay u yarayd oo hal mar ma dhicin.
x-m-el-sta-05.s.s1.o.d: Xaaladda B. Natiijo sidan oo kale ah kama soo bixin qalinjabinta lacag cadaalad ah
x-m-el-sta-05.s.s1.r.d: Marka tirada tijaabooyinku kordhay, waxaad heshay natiijo adag in lagu sharaxo fursad oo keliya.
x-m-el-sta-05.s.s1.explain: Xataa lacag cadaalad ah, 7 madax ama ka badan 10 ka mid ah way badanaa dhacdaa (qiyaastii 17%), laakiin 70 madax ama ka badan 100 ka mid ah weligood ma dhicin qalinjabinta. Xataa isla saamiga, tuuris badan ayaa ka dhigta mid adag in fursad lagu sharaxo. Tani waa fikradda aasaasiga ah ee tijaabinta male-awaal.
x-m-el-sta-05.s.s2.prompt: Natiijada Xaaladda B, ma 100% ayaad hubtaa in 'lacagtan loo sameeyey inay madax badan ku dhacdo'? Qor xukunkaaga iyo sababta.
x-m-el-sta-05.s.s2.hint.0: Akhri natiijada qalinjabinta (나), oo ku qor hal jumlad sida xoog leh ee natiijadaas u taageerto gabagabada ah inay tahay 'lacag been abuur ah'.
x-m-el-sta-05.s.s2.hint.1: Adigoo isticmaalaya qalinjabinta (b) sida caddayn, sheeg sida naadir u ah natiijo sidan oo kale ah lacag cadaalad ah.
x-m-el-sta-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma xukunkaagu wuxuu sheegayaa intee le'eg ayay tahay shaki, halkii uu ka noqon lahaa 'hubaal maya' ama 'hubaal haa'?
x-m-el-sta-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma isticmaashay natiijada qalinjabinta sida caddayn?
x-m-el-sta-05.s.s2.model.0: Ma hubin karno. Xataa lacag cadaalad ah ayaa si aad u naadir ah siin karta 70 madax. Laakiin aad bay u naadir tahay in lagu magacaabo fursad, sidaa darteed aad bay u badan tahay inay lacagtu been abuur ahayd.
x-m-el-sta-05.s.s2.model.1: Way adag tahay in si hubaal ah loo yiraahdo. Suurtagalnimada ah in lacag cadaalad ah ay fursad ahaan siiso natiijadan maaha 0. Laakiin qalinjabinta weligeed ma dhicin, sidaa darteed waxaa mudan in la shakiyo.
x-m-el-sta-05.s.s2.model.2: Ma aha 100% hubaal. Helitaanka 70 madax ama ka badan 100 tuurid oo lacag cadaalad ah weligeed ma dhicin xataa hal mar 1000 qalinjabin ah, sidaa darteed waa naadir ku filan inay shaki keento, laakiin suurtagalnimada ah inay fursad tahay maaha 0.
x-m-el-sta-05.s.s2.model.3: Ma odhan karo waa hubaal, laakiin waa natiijo ku dhawaad weligeed aan soo bixin lacag cadaalad ah, sidaa darteed waxay u badan tahay inay lacagtu been abuur ahayd.

x-m-el-sta-10.title: Sawirista xogta jawaab-badan sida jaantus goobo ah
x-m-el-sta-10.goal: Hel sababta boqolkiibaha xogta jawaab-badan aan loogu muujin karin jaantus goobo ah, oo dooro garaaf ku habboon.
x-m-el-sta-10.material: Dugsi mid ah, dhammaan 100-ka arday waa laga waydiiyey, 'Dooro dhammaan ciyaaraha aad jeceshahay (waxaad dooran kartaa wax ka badan hal),' oo warbixin ayaa la qoray.
x-m-el-sta-10.thinking.0: Xukun haddii nooca garaafku ku habboon yahay dabeecadda xogta
x-m-el-sta-10.thinking.1: Sharax sababta wadarta ay uga badan tahay 100%
x-m-el-sta-10.prereq.0: Macnaha jaantus goobo ah iyo saamiga
x-m-el-sta-10.s.s1.prompt: Dooro hal safka khaldan ee warbixinta.
x-m-el-sta-10.s.s1.hint.0: Hel waxa aad hesho marka aad isku darto dhammaan afarta boqolkiiba.
x-m-el-sta-10.s.s1.hint.1: Xusuuso in qaybaha jaantuska goobo ahi ay u kala qaybiyaan wadarta iyagoo aan is dulsaarin.
x-m-el-sta-10.s.s1.line.0: 60 arday ayaa doortay kubbadda cagta, 45 ayaa doortay kubbadda koryada, 30 ayaa doortay kubbadda gacanta, 25 na waxay doorteen xadhig-boodka.
x-m-el-sta-10.s.s1.line.1: Boqolkiiba ardayda doortay ciyaar kasta waa kubbadda cagta 60%, kubbadda koryada 45%, kubbadda gacanta 30%, iyo xadhig-boodka 25%.
x-m-el-sta-10.s.s1.line.2: Haddii boqolkiibyadan lagu muujiyo jaantus goobo ah, xagallada dhexe ee afarta qaybood waa 216 darajo, 162 darajo, 108 darajo, iyo 90 darajo.
x-m-el-sta-10.s.s1.line.3: Haddii aad isku darto dhammaan afarta qaybood, waxay sameeyaan hal goobo buuxa.
x-m-el-sta-10.s.s1.line.4: Sidaas darteed waxaan odhan karnaa 60% ardayda oo dhan ayaa doortay kubbadda cagta.
x-m-el-sta-10.s.s1.explain: Safafka 3 iyo 4 ayaa ah dhibaatada. Maadaama doorashooyin badan la oggolaaday, hal arday ayaa doortay ciyaaro dhowr ah, sidaas darteed boqolkiibyadu waxay isku darayaan 160%, xagallada dhexena waxay isku darayaan 576 darajo, taasoo ka badan hal wareeg oo buuxa oo goobada (360 darajo). Safka 5 waa sax, sababtoo ah 60 ka mid ah 100-ka arday ayaa doortay kubbadda cagta.
x-m-el-sta-10.s.s2.prompt: Waa kuma garaafka ugu habboon ee si daacad ah u muujinaya xogtan?
x-m-el-sta-10.s.s2.hint.0: Kala sooc haddii shayada garaafku yihiin qaybo aan is dulsaarin ama qiimayaal gooni gooni ah.
x-m-el-sta-10.s.s2.hint.1: Hubi haddii boqolkiiba shay kasta uu leeyahay isla hooseeye 100 arday.
x-m-el-sta-10.s.s2.o.a: U qaybi boqolkiibyada 160 si ay u isku daraan 100%, sawir jaantus goobo ah, oo ka dhig cinwaanka sida uu yahay
x-m-el-sta-10.s.s2.r.a: Haddii aad beddesho qiimayaasha, waxay noqonayaan 'boqolkiiba jawaabaha' halkii 'boqolkiiba ardayda,' taasoo aan la jaanqaadayn cinwaanka.
x-m-el-sta-10.s.s2.o.b: Ka dhig jaantuska goobo ah sida uu yahay oo ku qor 'wadar 160%' far yar hoostiisa
x-m-el-sta-10.s.s2.r.b: Tani waxay ku dartaa sharaxaad garaaf jebiya xeerka ah in goobada oo dhan ay tahay wadarta.
x-m-el-sta-10.s.s2.o.c: U beddel jaantuska goobo ah garaaf baar oo ku muuji, baar kasta, boqolkiibka ardayda doortay ciyaartaas
x-m-el-sta-10.s.s2.r.c: Waxaad doortay nooc garaaf ah oo muujin kara ciyaar kasta sida shay madaxbanaan.
x-m-el-sta-10.s.s2.o.d: U kala qaybi kubbadda cagta iyo 'inta kale,' sawir jaantus goobo ah oo leh laba qaybood, oo u isticmaal 45+30+25 inta kale
x-m-el-sta-10.s.s2.r.d: Isku darka inta kale wuxuu siinayaa 100%, taasoo ka duwan 40% ardayda aan doorannin kubbadda cagta. Qiimayaasha laba jeer la tiriyey weli way jiraan.
x-m-el-sta-10.s.s2.explain: Xogta jawaab-badan, hal arday wuxuu ku dhacaa shay dhowr ah, sidaas darteed boqolkiibyadu way isku darmi karaan wax ka badan 100%. Xaaladdan, muujinta shay kasta si gooni ah iyadoo leh baarkiisa ayaa ku habboon dabeecadda xogta.

x-m-el-sta-07.title: Haddii aan seexanno wax badan, ma dhibcuhu way kordhayaan?
x-m-el-sta-07.goal: Kala sooc waxa xogta isku xiriirka sheegto iyo waxa aysan sheegin, oo naqshadee nooca daraasad ee loo baahan yahay si loo hubiyo sababta.
x-m-el-sta-07.material: Sahan ayaa diiwaangeliyey celceliska wakhtiga hurdada maalinlaha ah ee 200 arday iyo dhibcahooda imtixaanka xisaabta. Marka dhibcaha lagu sawiro dusha, dhibcuhu waxay u fidaan xagga midigta sare, taasoo la micno ah dhibcuhu guud ahaan waa sare marka wakhtiga hurdadu dheeraado. Isku-dhufteyaasha isku xiriirku waa qiyaastii 0.6. Ardaydu waxay ku noolaayeen sida caadiga ah, qofna lama dhigin inuu beddelo wakhtiga hurdadiisa.
x-m-el-sta-07.thinking.1: Kala sooc isku xiriirka iyo sababta
x-m-el-sta-07.thinking.2: Naqshadee daraasad si loo hubiyo sababta
x-m-el-sta-07.prereq.0: Macnaha sawirka kala firdhisan iyo isku-dhufteyaasha isku xiriirka (isku xiriir togan, isku xiriir taban)
x-m-el-sta-07.s.s1.prompt: Dooro wax kasta oo laga odhan karo xogta sahankan oo keliya.
x-m-el-sta-07.s.s1.hint.0: Kala sooc haddii jumlad kasta ay leedahay 'waxay wada isbeddelaan' ama 'beddelidda midka ayaa beddesha kan kale.'
x-m-el-sta-07.s.s1.hint.1: Mar kale akhri cidda go'aamisay wakhtiga hurdada sahanka.
x-m-el-sta-07.s.s1.o.a: Haddii aad kordhiso wakhtiga hurdada, qof kasta dhibcihiisu waa kordhaan
x-m-el-sta-07.s.s1.r.a: 'Qof kasta' wuxuu ku dabaqayaa u janjeerka qof kasta. Sahankani ma aha tijaabo wakhtiga hurdada la beddelay.
x-m-el-sta-07.s.s1.o.b: Ardayda leh wakhtiga hurdada dheer waxay u janjeeraan dhibco sare
x-m-el-sta-07.s.s1.r.b: Waxaad si sax ah u akhrisay macnaha isku xiriirka, u janjeerka inay wada isbeddelaan.
x-m-el-sta-07.s.s1.o.c: Marka dhibcuhu kordhaan, ardaydu way ka sii seexdaan si fiican
x-m-el-sta-07.s.s1.r.c: Tarjumidda jihada si ka soo horjeeda sidoo kale lagama xaqiijin karo xogtan oo keliya.
x-m-el-sta-07.s.s1.o.d: Waxaa laga yaabaa inay jiraan arday xogtan ku jira oo seexda wakhti dheer laakiin leh dhibco hooseeya
x-m-el-sta-07.s.s1.r.d: Waxaad ogaatay in u janjeeruhu uusan ka muuqan arday kasta si isku mid ah.
x-m-el-sta-07.s.s1.o.e: Xogtani waxay muujisaa inaan xiriir u dhexeynin wakhtiga hurdada iyo dhibcaha
x-m-el-sta-07.s.s1.r.e: Isku-dhufteyaasha isku xiriirka 0.6 aad bay uga fog tahay xiriir la'aan (u dhow 0).
x-m-el-sta-07.s.s1.explain: Isku xiriirku wuxuu kuu sheegayaa u janjeerka ay wada isbeddelaan oo keliya, ma aha sababta. Maadaama ay tahay u janjeer, waxaa jira arday ka reeban.
x-m-el-sta-07.s.s2.prompt: Sidee daraasad loo naqshadeeyaa si loo ogaado haddii kordhinta wakhtiga hurdada ay kor u qaado dhibcaha (haddii ay tahay sababta)? Qor hal ama laba weedh.
x-m-el-sta-07.s.s2.hint.0: Ka fikir cidda go'aamin karta wakhtiga hurdada, halkii ardaydu go'aamin lahaayeen.
x-m-el-sta-07.s.s2.hint.1: Ka fikir sida loo kala qaybiyo labada koox ee la barbar dhigayo si ay cadaalad u noqoto.
x-m-el-sta-07.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma hubisay in arrimaha kale marka laga reebo wakhtiga hurdada ee saameeya dhibcuhu ay si isku mid ah ugu faafsan yihiin labada koox?
x-m-el-sta-07.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Naqshaddaadu ma ka madhan tahay waxyeello ardayda?
x-m-el-sta-07.s.s2.model.0: U kala qaybi ardayda si random ah laba koox, ka dhig hal koox oo keliya inay seexato wakhti dheer 2 toddobaad, oo barbar dhig isbeddelka dhibcaha imtixaanka ee labada koox.
x-m-el-sta-07.s.s2.model.1: U qaybi ardayda isku jaad ah adigoo isticmaalaya saami, ka dhig hal dhinac oo keliya inuu hore u seexdo iyadoo shuruudaha kale ay isku mid yihiin, ka dibna barbar dhig dhibcaha.

x-m-el-sta-08.title: Ma dab-damiyeyaal badan ayaa macnaheedu yahay waxyeello badan?
x-m-el-sta-08.goal: Hel safka warbixin ee ka booda isku xiriirka ilaa sababta, oo dib u qor gudaha waxa xogtu sheegi karto.
x-m-el-sta-08.material: Kani waa qayb ka mid ah warbixinta dabka ee magaalo.
x-m-el-sta-08.thinking.2: Dib u qor sida jumlad xogtu taageerto
x-m-el-sta-08.prereq.0: Macnaha isku xiriirka (u janjeerka ay wada isbeddelaan)
x-m-el-sta-08.s.s1.prompt: Dooro hal safka xogtu aysan taageerin.
x-m-el-sta-08.s.s1.hint.0: Saf kasta u kala sooc haddii uu leeyahay 'waxay wada isbeddelaan' ama 'waa sababta.'

x-m-el-sta-06.s.s1.explain: Ee 40÷√n ≤ 4, waxaad u baahan tahay √n ≥ 10, taasi waa, n ≥ 100, miisaaniyaddu na waxay siinaysaa n ≤ 120. Sidaa darteed tiro dhan kasta oo laga bilaabo 100 ilaa 120 way shaqeysaa.
x-m-el-sta-06.s.s2.prompt: Sahamiyuhu wuxuu kordhiyaa cabbirka muunadda 100 ilaa 400 wuxuuna yiraahdaa, 'Hadda qiyaastu ma khaldami karto.' Waa maxay qiimaynta ugu habboon?
x-m-el-sta-06.s.s2.hint.0: Geli n=100 iyo n=400 qaacidada oo barbar dhig xadka khaladka.
x-m-el-sta-06.s.s2.hint.1: Kala sooc waxa cabbirka muunadda weyn yareeyo iyo waxa uusan yarayn karin.
x-m-el-sta-06.s.s2.o.a: Sax. Iyadoo 400 qof, celceliska muunaddu wuxuu le'eg yahay celceliska dadweynaha si kasta oo muunadda loo doorto
x-m-el-sta-06.s.s2.r.a: Xitaa haddii muunaddu weynaato, celceliska muunaddu si sax ah ugama noqdo celceliska dadweynaha. Tani waxay sii run tahay haddii habka doorashadu eexsan yahay.
x-m-el-sta-06.s.s2.o.b: Xadka khaladku wuu badhaa, laakiin haddii muunadda si eex leh loo doortay, eexdu way hartaa
x-m-el-sta-06.s.s2.r.b: Waxaad kala saartay khaladka cabbirku yareeyo iyo eexda ka timaada sida muunadda loo doorto.
x-m-el-sta-06.s.s2.o.c: Khalad. Kordhinta cabbirka muunaddu ma yareyso xadka khaladka gabi ahaanba
x-m-el-sta-06.s.s2.r.c: Qaacidada, marka n weynaado, 40÷√n way yaraataa. Adigu geli n=100 iyo n=400 oo barbar dhig.
x-m-el-sta-06.s.s2.o.d: Xadka khaladku wuxuu noqonayaa hal rubuc, sidaas darteed qiyaastu way adag tahay inay khaldanto
x-m-el-sta-06.s.s2.r.d: Marka n noqdo 4 jeer ka weyn, √n wuxuu noqdaa 2 jeer ka weyn, sidaas darteed xadka khaladku ma aha hal rubuc. Adigu geli qiimayaasha oo hubi.
x-m-el-sta-06.s.s2.explain: Marka n ka tago 100 ilaa 400, taasoo ah 4 jeer ka weyn, √n wuxuu noqdaa 2 jeer ka weyn, sidaas darteed xadka khaladku wuu badhaa, 4 daqiiqo ilaa 2 daqiiqo. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, eexda ka timaada sida muunadda loo doortay ma baxdo marka aad kordhiso cabbirka.
